data.gender_notes: Kori is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Kori was the goddess of the dawn, symbolizing the beginning of a new day. This name embodies the essence of renewal, hope, and the power of new beginnings. In Christian tradition, Kori is associated with the resurrection and the promise of eternal life. The name Kori carries the meaning “Daughter of the sun” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kori usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and new beginnings.
data.etymology: Kori belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of the sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kori total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
